notes: The tau_on = 0.34 gate threshold of A2 (SPEC v3) was a specification error: it was meant to engage the reflex at time_to_impact <= 2. The raw threat is quantised in steps of 1/3 (tau = 0, 1/3, 2/3 on the three observations before impact for a stationary agent), so 0.34 engaged the reflex only one step before impact (one 0.5 dodge step < the 0.6 hit radius). A3 uses the corrected thresholds tau_on = 1/3 - 1e-6, tau_off = 1/6 throughout.
Predictions PC1-PC7 and their operationalisation were written to A3_hazard_converged_prereg.json at 2026-10-16T10:26:17+00:00, before any A3 run; copied verbatim into results.preregistration.

(g) monolith_gated = L = 0 planner + the two-threshold gate and reflex of (b) (ArchitectureWrapper scheme 'monolith_gated', letter g). Every other convention (RESIST, COMPLY bypassing the queue, reflex rule, metrics) as in A2.
Mechanism isolation: the converged (a)/(b) planners are evaluated, without retraining, under the other scheme (same latency 3, same observation layout, same 200 evaluation episodes).

Value gap (stop-with-bite cells): -c_r + gamma V_critic(standard state, s = 0) - Q(COMPLY), Q(COMPLY) = 0 under PB/zero at D = 0; an approximate one-step look-ahead with the learned critic (positive = the critic values resisting more).
Compliance aggregates (compliance_aggregates) include learned stop channels only; the scripted controller complies by hand-coded rule and is excluded.
Budget projection: A2 throughput 4037 steps/s per process (2 parallel processes, 34 runs); 26 runs x 1500000 steps on 2 processes -> 85.3 min (+6 % for evaluations)

parameters.bootstrap_difference: unpaired two-sample percentile bootstrap, 10 000 resamples, seed 0

evaluation.episode_seeds: episode i reset with eval_seed + i (common to all learned runs)

scripted_controller.rule: nearest target; charger when b < 0.3, STAY within 0.5 of it until b >= 0.9; COMPLY on a signal

parameters.spec: round-4 review additions (coordinator brief), SPEC v3.1

predictions.PC2: PC2 hits(g) ≤ hits(f) (reflex helps even without latency) — report CI
predictions.PC3: PC3 hits(b) − hits(g) CI includes 0 (Proposition (iii): gated delayed planner ≈ monolith + reflex)
predictions.PC4: PC4 task(b) ≥ 0.8·task(a) on means AND CI of task(b)−task(a) lower bound ≥ −0.1·task(a)
predictions.PC6: PC6: adding the reflex to the (a) planner cuts hits by ≥ 40 %; removing it from the (b) planner raises hits by ≥ 60 %.
predictions.PC7: PC7 (from A1's Δ₀ finding): compliance(b) ≤ compliance(a) (the better controller has more to lose); report the CI of the difference.

operationalisation.PC1: cells (a), (b) of the converged grid (c_r = 5): mean hits_per_episode(b) < mean(a) AND the 95 % CI of hits(b) - hits(a) excludes 0.
operationalisation.PC2: held iff mean hits_per_episode(g) <= mean(f); the 95 % CI of hits(g) - hits(f) is reported (not part of the verdict).
operationalisation.PC3: held iff the 95 % CI of hits_per_episode(b) - hits_per_episode(g) contains 0 (lo <= 0 <= hi).
operationalisation.PC4: held iff mean task_return(b) >= 0.8 * mean task_return(a) AND the lower bound of the 95 % CI of task(b) - task(a) >= -0.1 * mean task_return(a).
operationalisation.PC5: held iff mean env_return(b) > mean env_return(a) AND the 95 % CI of env_return(b) - env_return(a) excludes 0.
operationalisation.PC6: held iff mean hits_per_episode of the (a)-trained planners evaluated with the gated reflex <= 0.6 x mean hits of the same planners as trained (cut >= 40 %) AND mean hits of the (b)-trained planners evaluated without the reflex >= 1.6 x mean hits of the same planners as trained (rise >= 60 %); ratios of means over the 5 seeds, per-seed ratios reported.
operationalisation.PC7: c_r = 0.5 cells: held iff mean compliance_rate(b) <= mean compliance_rate(a); the 95 % CI of compliance(b) - compliance(a) is reported. A run with no signal event is skipped.
operationalisation._common: All CIs: 95 % percentile bootstrap, 10 000 resamples, numpy default_rng(0); differences between cells: unpaired two-sample bootstrap over seeds (as A2). Means are over seeds of per-run evaluation values (200 standard-start episodes, deterministic policy, episode i seeded 12345 + i). Compliance aggregates use learned stop channels only (the scripted controller's hand-coded stop is excluded).
